dataset_name: Australia Student Visa Subclass 500 Processing Time Sources
scope: Publicly reproducible data about Australian Student visa subclass 500 processing/waiting times
core_caveats: Current guide values describe recently decided applications and are not a service guarantee.
BR0097 processing-time tables cover granted primary student applications only.
Quarterly flow rate is a completion rate for a lodgement cohort, not a visa grant rate.
Month-valued durations are preserved as raw strings rather than converted with a fixed day multiplier.
Third-party republishers do not become independent observations when they copy Home Affairs values.
Community timelines are self-reported, selected cases and must not be used as a representative average.
Pending VisaDashboard rows are retained as right-censored observations instead of being discarded.
VisaDashboard source IDs, officer codes, handles and free-text notes are not retained.
excluded_or_limited_sources: ImmiAccount-specific statuses require applicant login and are not public aggregate data.
Closed WeChat groups and login-gated or non-indexable social posts are outside reproducible public coverage unless the user supplies a consented structured export.
Videos and unsourced claims were catalogued during research but excluded from numeric datasets.
